reviewMode: Independent read-only source review. No production files changed and no test suite repeated by this reviewer.
conclusion: No blocking substantive defect identified in the reviewed code. This is a static review, not a claim of new end-to-end or real-model execution.
checked: The convenience-store/location-services import cycle reads the opposite catalog only from functions after module initialization; no eager top-level cross-cycle access was found.

Validated narrative actions execute sequentially on a parsed private clone. Final state, story and phone messages are committed through one save; later action failure does not persist earlier partial changes.
Exact rest minutes use the shared clock/nutrition advance. Actions crossing the maximum day fail before a clone can be persisted.
Phone timestamps are constructed from the final world clock after the full action sequence.
Canonical action fingerprints distinguish replayed action contents. Retained story turns protect their action receipts from journal churn; duplicate IDs are checked before execution.
New story study durations agree with academic parser bounds; clearInteriorActivity clears incompatible old room rest/study records.

Takeaway items derive from authored service effects, enter the inventory whitelist and can be parsed after reload. Packing pays and adds inventory without consumption; later use spends one unit and nutrition once.
Gifting verifies owned quantity and known contact, deducts actual use units, applies bounded affinity and does not grant player food/energy benefits.
Existing schema 1.10.0 state structure remains; historical data is not resettled by parsing.
Lifecycle checks the active request/session before commit, saves before assigning displayed state, then starts phone delivery.
limitations: Existing automated tests were inspected for relevant coverage but not rerun by this reviewer.
No real model request, native SillyTavern UI validation or physical TauriTavern validation was performed.
Permanent replay protection after both bounded story history and receipts are pruned is not asserted.
Packaging and installed-card verification is pending the separate independent audit after installation.
